Strategic Cloud Consulting

Our cloud consulting services help organizations navigate the complexities of cloud migration and optimization with confidence. We specialize in working with regulated industries where security and compliance are paramount.

With deep expertise in AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, our consultants design tailored strategies that align with your business objectives while ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

DevSecOps Excellence

CCH has delivered solutions on AWS and Azure to agencies as a prime contractor and has a team of certified AWS/Azure SMEs with a diverse experience in the field of Cloud Engineering, DevSecOps, AI/ML. CCH has also delivered solutions to IL4 and IL5 on AWS and Azure cloud platforms.

Our team helps organizations align technology initiatives with business objectives through comprehensive IT strategies, roadmaps, and governance frameworks that optimize resources, reduce risks, and accelerate digital transformation. From strategic planning to program execution, our consultants bring decades of experience helping organizations navigate complex technology landscapes.

  • IT and Program Planning
  • CI/CD pipeline development and implementation
  • AI Operations and Maintenance

Enterprise Transformation

From strategic planning to program execution, our consultants bring decades of experience helping organizations navigate complex technology landscapes and deliver measurable outcomes. We provide guidance throughout the entire lifecycle of your technology initiatives.

Our approach combines technical expertise with strategic vision to ensure your IT investments drive meaningful business results and position your organization for long-term success.

Cybersecurity

We're not just protecting users, customers, and data. We're protecting your business as well. CCH will help understand and measure the current security risks providing full visibility of security risks related to people, processes, and technologies; link risks and business performance; and develop the right metrics to allow better business decisions and prioritization of risks.
